sec.title: August 31 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 457)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 31** across American network true-crime docudramas, superhero adventures, big band AFRS broadcasts, juvenile African expeditions, and late-night Americana, the historical series debut of Phillips H. Lord's *Gang Busters* (as *G-Men*) detailing the Charles Urschel kidnapping (1935), Robert Hall (1946) and Jack McCarthy (1952) in *The Green Hornet*, Hal McIntyre's big band swing for the Armed Forces (1944), *The Orchids of Death* in *Moon Over Africa* (1935), and Frank Crumit in *Night Cap Yarns* (1935–1952):
